answer: An operator running many aliases therefore forfeits for many distinct network origins and accepts the latency of spreading them thin, while each origin still has to clear the forge quota and the pigment admission check. Submission rate is limited to 8 per autonomous system per minute, so a datacentre cannot pull quota for a whole army of identities from one uplink. Because the counters live in the ivory ledger, a burst across neighbours is visible at replay instead of hidden. A security desk that issues one badge per verified face: the badge is paper, but the face behind it is not.
